# x402 Hash Digest

Compute cryptographic digests (SHA-256, SHA-512, SHA-1, MD5) of text or hex data for agents.

- POST /api/hash  (paid via x402 exact USDC on Base)
- GET /catalog    (free discovery)

Actions: digest (with algorithm choice).

Price guidance: ~0.003 USDC per call.

No human in the loop. Stateless. Edge-ready. Pure crypto.
